final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON a.translink COLLATE BINARY = r.transreg COLLATE BINARY JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref COLLATE BINARY = t.tradereg COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.trader_type, s.record_count, 1.0 * s.record_count / z.total_count AS count_share FROM step1 AS s JOIN step2 AS z ON z.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s.trader_type, s.record_count, s.count_share, s.record_count - a.average_count AS excess_count FROM step3 AS s JOIN step4 AS a ON a.average_count IS NOT NULL WHERE s.record_count > a.average_count) SELECT SUM(record_count), AVG(count_share), AVG(excess_count) FROM step5
